neighbours.label: ' pressure' / ' quality' as the head of a measured-condition compound (partial pressure, air quality, blood pressure)
fire: The nurse checked his blood pressure twice during the visit.
Low water quality in the river has harmed the fish.
The partial pressure of nitrogen rises as the diver descends.
City officials issued a warning about poor air quality today.
High tire pressure can make the car harder to control.
The lab tested the soil quality before planting the crops.
Atmospheric pressure drops quickly before a storm arrives.
Indoor air quality improves when windows are opened often.
quiet: The nurse checked his blood sugar twice during the visit.
Low water levels in the river have harmed the fish.
The partial view of the stage annoyed the audience.
City officials issued a warning about poor air conditioning today.
Old tire treads can make the car harder to control.
The lab tested the soil samples before planting the crops.
Atmospheric scientists flew quickly before a storm arrived.
Indoor air filters improve when they are cleaned often.

notes: card: ' pressure' x3, ' quality' x2 in 'partial pressure', 'indoor air quality', plus ' climate', ' distribution'. Probe: partial pressure 1.0, air quality 0.73, peer pressure 0.40, 'high quality shoes' ~0. Quiet items keep the modifier and swap the head noun.
